title: Rubicon Research Ltd - 544578 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 44% YoY to INR5,140m with EBITDA margin ~23%, but management is outsourcing more manufacturing as internal capacity is constrained and Pithampur ramp is pushed to CY27; capex deliberately lagging demand.
